protocol: Use the same cached scores and 70:30 standardized blend in every edit arm. Admit the best outsider if it outranks the weakest incumbent. The two one-swap arms use identical membership. Reordering the same ten keeps the original membership. The abstention run keeps accepted six-pair decisions. Tie-breaking follows the dense rank. Qrels are used exclusively for scoring, including a diagnostic oracle that picks the best output among the five already-scored lists.
